notes: <sandbox>/work in argv stands for a fresh scratch copy of this run's inputs/ folder, mounted at /w; the inputs are kept under inputs/ as they ran.
Each log is the container's stdout followed by its stderr. verdict_lines are the lines of the log the recorder keeps (content/audit/tools/record-exemplars.mjs), copied in log order.

A scenario's result is ruled out when it meets the query's own assertions about the post-state (for an SMT-LIB file, its last assertion, with the result's values asserted): it is then one of the violations the unsat excludes. A result the query never considers, one whose total is not 100 when the total is assumed, is not ruled out.
